name: mt_bench_japanese
description: A Japanese-language variant of MT-Bench designed to evaluate models' helpfulness, correctness, and safety in Japanese. It measures instruction-following and open-ended conversational abilities in Japanese across a set of prompts, typically scored via human or automated pairwise evaluation. Used to compare multilingual and Japanese-specialized LLMs.
reputation: Derivative of MT-Bench targeted at the Japanese community; used for comparative evaluations of Japanese-capable LLMs but not yet as widely adopted as English MT-Bench.
